title: Beyond Harnack Rigidity
summary: The boundary of a plane amoeba is always contained in its contour, and equality is a characteristic feature of simple Harnack curves. We show that the converse fails, even under strong smoothness and nondegeneracy assumptions. For every two-dimensional lattice polygon, except unimodular triangles, we construct a smooth Newton-nondegenerate curve with smooth logarithmic critical locus and smooth embedded contour satisfying $\mathcal C(\mathscr A_f)=\partial\mathscr A_f$, although the curve is not Harnack.
